load_apartments_from_dict: load apartment listings from a dictionary into the ApartmentListingApp for simulation
list_all_apartments: list all loaded apartments in the ApartmentListingApp and return their details
get_apartment_details: get detailed information for a specific apartment by its apartment_id
search_apartments: search apartments by location, price range, bedrooms, pet policy, and amenities
save_and_remove_apartment: save an apartment to favorites or remove it from saved apartments
